headline: NPR finds open models stripped of safeguards in minutes
body: A quiet day. NPR documented thousands of altered open-weight models used for scams and extremism, and showed safeguards on Gemma 3 and Llama 3.3 can be removed with public tools. That chips at Alignment & Control, nudging Conquerors up and Protector God down by hundredths. Zookeeper edged past Egalitarian Utopia. Horizon Balance is 0.4, down 0.06.
movers_note: No ending moved by 0.1 or more; Conquerors +0.0 and Protector God -0.0, from the NPR report (+0.05/-0.05).
